meta.name: dev-learner
meta.description: Meta-skill — extract reusable skills from the current conversation. Identifies patterns that appeared 3+ times and proposes them as new skills. Pairs with skill-creator builtin.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话中提取重复模式并生成可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在对话中重复做类似操作，想将其固化为技能
copy.tagline_en: Extract reusable skills from conversation patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar operations in conversations and want to turn them into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扫描当前对话，找出重复3次以上的工作流、提示、输出或交接模式，并提议将模式提取为新技能，生成学习报告。
howto.when: 当用户进行长对话，有重复3次以上的相同流程，或希望将手动重复的模式正式化为技能时触发。常用于回顾EPIC后或技能复盘。

say.text: 帮我从这次对话中提取重复出现的工作模式。
say.note: Claude会扫描并列出检测到的模式。

say.text: 扫描一下，有哪些步骤我重复了三次以上？
say.note: Claude会识别重复操作并提出新技能建议。

say.text: 把常用的调试流程做成一个技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans the current conversation for patterns (workflows, prompts, outputs, handoffs) that appeared 3+ times and proposes extracting them as reusable skills, generating a learner report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user has a long session with repeated workflows (3+ times) or wants to formalize manual patterns into skills. Often used after EPIC retrospectives or skill review.

say_en.text: Extract repeated workflow patterns from this conversation.
say_en.note: Claude scans and lists detected patterns.

say_en.text: Find steps I repeated more than three times.
say_en.note: Claude identifies repeated operations and suggests new skills.

say_en.text: Turn the common debugging flow into a skill.
say_en.note: Claude generates a skill proposal and calls skill-creator.
